subject: bgiteration: fix barrier item count for swap/flush during termination (#4750)
reason: The fix removes a double-decrement of bgIterator.barrier_items that only occurs when queued SWAPDB/FLUSHDB barrier items are drained during iterator termination. Those barrier items are queued exclusively for non-consistent background iterators: handleSwapdb (bgiteration.c:1801) queues SWAPDB only when the iterator lacks BGITERATOR_FLAG_CONSISTENT, and handleFlushdb (bgiteration.c:1840) queues a FLUSHDB barrier item only when it does NOT abort/terminate, which for a consistent iterator it always does. In this build the sole production bgIterator is the forkless disk save, created with BGITERAT
